summary: Iteration 16 backend regression tests executed via pytest against http://localhost:8001. Covers photo upload (happy + 2 negative), delete-account (3 cases), admin tier entitlements (grant pro_plus, ultra, revoke fallback, revoke to free, unknown-tier 400), fridge Pro+ gating (test3 → 402, fresh Pro+ user → 200), and courses[].icon persistence on preferences. All 14 tests PASS.
action_items: Note (non-blocking): the courses-icon test PUTs {courses:[{id:'primo', ...}]} for test3, which by design fully replaces test3's course list. If a future test needs test3 to have the default multi-course preferences, re-seed or amend the test to include all defaults. test3's tier remained 'pro' (untouched).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1886 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, dishes, planner, fridge, upload, admin) to keep files <700 lines.

PUT /api/auth/preferences replaces the entire `courses` array whenever the field is provided (no merge). This is expected given the mode='merge'|'replace' pattern used elsewhere, but the frontend must always send the full list when editing a single course icon to avoid clobbering others.
seed_data_creation: Each destructive test registers a fresh `t16_<ms_timestamp>_<n>` user via /api/auth/register and cleans up via DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id} in a fixture teardown. test3 and testlang01 were not modified (test3 tier verified as 'pro' post-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration16_upload_tiers_delete.py as regression. It exercises upload, delete-account, admin tier grants (pro/pro_plus/ultra + revoke fallback + unknown-tier rejection), fridge Pro+ gating, and preferences courses[].icon. Uses BACKEND_BASE_URL env or http://localhost:8001. Cleans up throwaway users via admin DELETE.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all target flows behave as specified. Client-side FormData bug (B1) was purely frontend and out of scope per request; server-side /api/upload/photo verified to correctly accept standard multipart/form-data and return {path,size,content_type}, and to return 400 for unsupported content-type and for empty files.
